faq.q: How do I scrape YouTube Shorts?
faq.a: Search by keyword, creator or hashtag; it returns only Shorts, with exact views, likes, comments, publish date, views per day and a viral score, ranked and filtered to a real date range.

faq.q: Is there a YouTube Shorts API?
faq.a: The YouTube Data API has no Shorts-only filter and its search calls are expensive in quota. This actor searches Shorts directly, no key needed.

faq.q: Can I use it as a YouTube Shorts API?
faq.a: Yes. Start a run from your own code with Apify's REST API (or the JavaScript and Python clients) and read the results as JSON; the run-sync endpoint returns the items in the same HTTP call. The same input also runs in the Apify Console, on a schedule, or from Make, Zapier and n8n.
